title: 发现重启之后出现命令面板功能，出现资源管理器进程参数错误

author_wait_evidence.detail: The maintainer requested the Command Palette hotkey and a fresh /bugreport; the author replied only with the requested command and has not yet supplied the report or hotkey.

judgment.rationale: The author follow-up narrows the symptom to CmdPal enablement: disabling CmdPal stops the explorer.exe parameter error, re-enabling it reproduces the problem, and the hotkey cannot be changed. The latest maintainer request asks for the configured hotkey and a fresh /bugreport, and the author has not supplied those evidence items yet. The older related investigation in #48436 remains relevant, but the new evidence request must be resolved before deciding whether this is the same launch failure or a distinct configuration/activation problem.
evidence: The reporter says the explorer.exe parameter error began after updating to PowerToys 0.100.2, is caused by Command Palette, disappears when CmdPal is disabled, and returns when it is re-enabled.
The reporter also says the Command Palette shortcut cannot be modified while the problem is present.
A maintainer asked for the configured Command Palette hotkey and a bug report on 2026-09-08; the next comment is /bugreport, but no generated report or hotkey value has been posted.
The issue is open with Issue-Bug, Needs-Triage, and Product-Command Palette labels, is unassigned, and is in the live Needs Attention project.
Open issue #48436 tracks a related Command Palette explorer.exe package/launch error, but it predates this report and does not establish that both failures are identical.
judgment.recommended_action: Wait for the author to provide the configured hotkey and a fresh /bugreport captured after reproducing the error, then compare the activation trace with #48436 before consolidating or designing a fix.

fix_assessment.rationale: A PowerToys code fix cannot be selected safely until the requested reproduction evidence identifies whether the failure is the known explorer.exe activation path, a hotkey registration problem, or an installation/version-specific issue.

issue_context.summary: The report now contains a clear symptom isolation to Command Palette, but the latest maintainer-requested hotkey and post-reproduction diagnostic evidence are still missing.
known_information: The issue reports PowerToys 0.100.2 on Windows 11 installed from GitHub.
The author attributes the explorer.exe parameter error to Command Palette after restart.
Disabling CmdPal removes the error; re-enabling it makes the problem return.
The author reports that the CmdPal hotkey cannot be modified while the problem is present.
The latest live labels are Issue-Bug, Needs-Triage, and Product-Command Palette; no assignee is set.
Maintainer Michael Jolley requested the hotkey and /bugreport on 2026-09-08.
The issue is present in GitHub project 1138, Needs Attention, with no project item for the related #50349 issue.
inferences: The failure is likely in CmdPal activation, registration, or hotkey/configuration handling, but the current public evidence does not distinguish those branches.
The inability to change the hotkey may be a second symptom of CmdPal not starting correctly rather than the trigger for the explorer.exe error.
The existing #48436 investigation may cover the same launch mechanism, but duplicate status is not proven without the requested trace.
issue_context.analysis: The new author comment materially improves the report by isolating the failure to CmdPal and identifying a repeatable disable/re-enable boundary. It still lacks the exact hotkey and a time-correlated diagnostic trace, which are the evidence needed to compare shell activation, package registration, and settings behavior. Because a maintainer has already requested those specific items and the author has not supplied them, the correct current state is waiting_on_author rather than a speculative fix design.
initial_investigation: Inspected src/modules/cmdpal/CmdPalModuleInterface/dllmain.cpp: CmdPal.enable registers the package if needed and launches explorer.exe with x-cmdpal://background; first enable uses a detached retry thread.
Inspected the current CmdPal launch path and found the explorer.exe activation mechanism remains in main.
Compared the public related issue #48436, which tracks a Command Palette explorer.exe package-unavailable error on Windows 11 25H2; no linked fix was found.
Reviewed all four live issue comments and the timeline, including removal of Needs-Author-Feedback after the author replied and the new maintainer request.
Checked live project context: #50416 is in project 1138, Needs Attention; #50349 has no project item.

information_gaps.information: The exact Command Palette hotkey configured when the error occurs.
information_gaps.why_needed: It distinguishes a hotkey registration/configuration failure from a general CmdPal package or explorer.exe activation failure.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Reply with the configured hotkey in text, without including unrelated private settings.

information_gaps.information: A fresh PowerToys diagnostic ZIP captured immediately after reproducing the error with CmdPal enabled.
information_gaps.why_needed: The activation and Runner/CmdPal logs are needed to compare this report with #48436 and identify whether explorer.exe, package registration, or hotkey setup fails first.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Reproduce once, then submit a comment containing /bugreport as requested by the maintainer.
